method.advancement: At least two new combined locations across two generator families, keep the existing useful location, at most one new ordinary group and no isolated-room flag. No serving eligibility from this exposed cohort.
method.combination: Standardize dense voice and acoustic return scores with per-feature median and IQR from ordinary development windows. Use the voice score plus half the nonnegative acoustic score capped at four IQR units. Keep the voice term when acoustic timing is unassessed. Retain the same one-second extent.
method.contrasts: Compute base-2 Jensen-Shannon divergence among each center and flank profile, and between the two flanks. Compare the weaker center-to-flank divergence with the same value minus between-flank divergence. A positive return suggests one transient spectral change, not AI origin.
method.points: Fix each new operating point at the maximum ordinary development score for its own readout. Preserve archived dense and original two-second points. Report fixed and retrospective matched false-group counts. Count useful at 50 percent coverage and 0.30 IoU.
method.sources: Repeat the original 40 development and 52 held mixtures from the isolation diagnostic. Only submitted PCM and previously committed original dense voice scores enter features. This is a new analysis on previously exposed audio.
method.spectral_profile: 512-sample Hann frames advance by 128 samples. Sum power into 24 logarithmic frequency bands from 250 to 6400 Hz; normalize each active frame to unit band mass, take componentwise segment medians and renormalize. Use the middle 840 ms of the one-second candidate and two 320 ms flanks separated from each candidate edge by 80 ms.
method.timing_coverage: Use only the existing admitted one-second positions with both flanks and supported nonzero frames. Missing flanks do not imply an unchanged recording.
